title: Video2DoorTraversal: Push Door Traversal via Simulated Door Twins
summary: A single-video real-to-sim-to-real pipeline reconstructs an instance-aligned articulated door twin, refines executable demonstrations in simulation, and trains coordinated approach, opening, and traversal control.

mechanisms.name: Single-video articulated door twin
mechanisms.description: Recover metric door geometry, appearance, articulation, and interaction structure from one real video so downstream simulation can reason about panels, handles, hinges, opening, and traversal.
inputs: single real RGB video of a door
mechanisms.limitations: The paper assumes a specific door video and robotic platform. Its traversal success rates do not establish BlindAssist visible-door identity, functional entrance selection, phone sensing, user completion, product benefit, or safety.
